definitions.short: a collar (as spread around the neck)
definitions.full: H7242. rabid רָבִיד noun [masculine] chain , ornament for neck; — absolute ׳ר Ezek 16:11 ; construct הַזָּהָב רְבִד Gen 41:42 (E).

occurrences.englishText: Pharaoh took off his signet ring from his hand, and put it on Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in robes of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck.
I decked you with ornaments, put bracelets on your hands, and put a chain on your neck.
